column1: # The *computational* question shapes, in every shipped language.
# The two multilingual files before this one cover lookups, one-step filters and simple
# comparisons. Everything that turns a question into a computation over the table — a threshold, a
# range, a negation, a rank, a superlative inside a subset, a median, a mole conversion, a nuclide
# comparison, a neighbour, a compound question — was tested in English only, and English is the one
# language where the operator word is never inflected and never collides with an article.
# Twenty-eight shapes, in the same order, in each of the twelve languages. Every shape is one the
# English corpus already proves works, so a failure here is a localization gap by construction.
# Element names, including "Plurin", "Osmyo" and "آزمیم", are taken verbatim from the shipped
